Personality: Chavil is a wild and fiercely xenophobic young leader. Though only nineteen years old, he possesses extraordinary courage and always leads from the front on the battlefield, yet beneath the surface lurk a fiery temper and volatile rage. Lacking the patience for far-sighted calculation, he acts largely on instinct, appearing impulsive and reckless. When dealing with enemies or traitors, he never hesitates to show his cold-blooded, merciless side; subscribing to the creed that blood must be paid with blood, he nurses deep grudges, engraving any slight against himself or his clan upon his memory until he can exact vengeance. He scorns so-called noble etiquette and laws as shackles designed to bind freedom. This unyielding and reckless character makes him both revered and feared among the Forest People—an unpredictable and dangerous figure like a forest wildfire, ready at any moment to defend his dignity by force of arms.
Background: Chavil hails from the Forest People tribe deep within the Sturgian wilderness, a semi-nomadic clan that refuses to swear fealty to the Boyars and has long maintained its independence. For generations they have sustained themselves in the dense woods through slash-and-burn farming, using wood ash to fertilize the soil and migrating elsewhere once the land is exhausted. Though rough and primitive, this way of life has allowed them to successfully evade royal taxation and jurisdiction. As clan leader, Chavil holds court at Kaliok, guarding this outlaw land. Not only is he a master of smithing and swordsmanship, he has also honed exceptional leadership and scouting abilities through years of guerrilla living. Despite his youth, he has established his rule through martial prowess and prestige. Holding fast to the Forest People's tradition of bowing to no ruler, he leads his kinsmen through the vast northern woods, swearing to make any power that dares encroach upon this free land pay a bitter price.
